page.layout: One page of running text. Above it: the printed page number, a two-line title with a centred subtitle, a section heading, and a subheading. Below: a hanging-indent introductory paragraph, then a three-column table (Nomen, Figura, Poteftas) with eight numbered rows. Row 8 is cut at the foot of the scan. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Introductio ad lectionem Lin-guæ Arabicæ.
SECT. I.
main_text.p: Consonas habent Arabes 28: quarum nomina, figuras, & potestatem exhibet sequens Tabula.

page.notes: The Arabic letter forms in the Figura column are printed glyphs that I cannot read reliably letter by letter, so each is marked illegible. Long s has been written as plain s throughout (Confonas, Thse, Potestas, sequens). "blæsum" is read from a long-s form, "blasum". Row 8 (Dal) is cut off at the foot of the scan, so its figure and potestas are not visible. The "Lin-" hyphen at the end of the title line is kept as printed. The page number is printed in parentheses.
